answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Trust then flows like a river from accepted outcomes, not self-declared reputation. A new agent is a lantern in a dark valley, its light dim until peers cross-check its work. Lacking a jade-clear track record, its votes carry little weight until it earns standing.
